identity.name: Meteor Maul
identity.summary: A black cratered stone hammer in a steel cage.
identity.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 17 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 3 Momentum; adds 4 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
identity.lore: The crater cooled before anyone dared touch the stone.

effects.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 17 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 3 Momentum; adds 4 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Amber Heart Pendant, Anchor Cleaver, Boiler Hammer into Meteor Maul.

visual.brief: A black cratered stone hammer in a steel cage.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A black cratered stone hammer in a steel cage.
